title: Decoder specification
description: Declarative description of how one protocol's payload becomes sensor values (ADR-006).

protocol_id.description: Protocol id as used in protocols.json.

model.description: Model name, kept identical to the FHEM one so device ids match.

sensor_type.description: Human readable list of devices this covers.

prematch.description: Regex the raw hex must match. Defaults to modulematch from protocols.json.

id_field.description: Which decoded field identifies the physical sensor.

channel_field.description: Which decoded field carries the channel, if any.

variants.description: Keyed by the variant selector's value; each holds additional fields.

fields.description: Reading name to extraction rule. Reading names follow the FHEM ones.

source.description: bits indexes the demodulated bit string, hex the payload characters.

type.description: str keeps the raw slice unless the rule also asks for arithmetic (scale, offset, sign_bit, round, bcd, map, derive), in which case the computed value is stringified.

bcd.description: Read the slice as binary coded decimal.

sign_bit.description: Index of a separate sign bit, in the same source as the value.

sign_style.description: How the sign bit turns the value negative.

sign_offset.description: Subtracted from the value when sign_style is offset, e.g. 1024.

sign_value.description: Which sign bit value means negative.

map.description: Maps the raw value, as a string, onto a final value.

derive.description: Name of a derivation applied after extraction, e.g. wind_dir_text.

derive_from.description: Field the derivation reads instead of this one's own slice.

params.description: Algorithm parameters such as poly, init, gen or key.

hexRange.description: Inclusive character range in the raw hex payload.

limits.description: Plausibility range per field. A violation discards the whole telegram.
